If the woman's family accepts the proposal after obtaining the consent of the woman, quantum of man is fixed by the head of bride's family and the date and venue for payment of marriage price and of solemnization of marriage are fixed;
The woman pays the marriage price through palai;
On the day marriage is solemnized and at the appointed time, the bride under escort by lawichal leaves her home and family to live with the bridegroom.
